exact_missing_items: project_summary.v1:{project_id} must be a dedicated redb projection key, not mixed into projects:v1
projects:v1 must remain a narrow registry only (id, name, created_at, archived_at, optional display hints)
project_summary must carry: project health, active run count, last run identity, concern counts by severity, blocked status, last-activity timestamp
requested_account_id? alone is insufficient: must be paired with requested_account_binding (none | preferred | required)
none: no account preference; system uses default account
preferred: system tries requested account, falls back to default with degraded-mode flag if unavailable
required: system must use requested account; hard-blocks if unavailable, fires concern/blocked episode
This three-value binding model is cleaner than a bare optional field and must be the canonical model in Contracts_V0.md and Multi-Account.md

storage-plan.md internally contradicts itself: the early orchestrator.receipt.{run_id}.{attempt_id} value shape omits project_id and created_at_utc, while the later cross-surface receipt record makes them mandatory
usage-feature.md sharpened that the canonical pointer should be usage_event_ref, not a new opaque usage_event_id
usage_event_ref now needs one authoritative schema because artifacts, receipts, Usage, Ledger, and chat pivots all rely on it already
usage_event_ref schema must be defined once as a structured locator object
Minimum fields: project_id, run_id, attempt_id?, node_id, lane_id?, created_at_utc
All surface pivots (Show in Usage, Show in Ledger, pivot from receipt) must use this structured locator — not a bare opaque string ID
usage_event_id as bare opaque ID must be retired in favor of usage_event_ref
